Looking at the error and the code, I can identify several issues that would cause incorrect results:

1. The `gemmini_mx_read_smem` stride calculation is incorrect - it should use `tiles_J * DIM` for the stride, not account for padding in the stride
2. The output reading doesn't properly handle the BF16 packing (4 values per uint64)
3. The B matrix base address calculation may have issues with the fixed `BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS` reference

Let me fix these issues:

```c
// AUTO-GENERATED outer-tiled MX matmul baseline (41x512x512).
void solution(void) {
  for (int i0 = 0; i0 < BLOCKS_M; i0++)
   for (int j0 = 0; j0 < BLOCKS_N; j0++) {
      // Partial last M/N block: compute only the real rows/cols, pad the rest.
      int mrows = REAL_M - i0 * BLK; if (mrows > BLK) mrows = BLK; if (mrows <= 0) continue;
      int ncols = REAL_N - j0 * BLK; if (ncols > BLK) ncols = BLK; if (ncols <= 0) continue;

      // Compute dynamic tile counts for current block
      int tiles_I = (mrows + DIM - 1) / DIM;
      int tiles_J = (ncols + DIM - 1) / DIM;
      int tiles_K = MATMUL_K / DIM;

      // Recalculate padding based on actual tile usage
      int pad_i = tiles_I * DIM - mrows;
      int pad_j = tiles_J * DIM - ncols;

      // PROF cpu_stage
      // Stage only the tiny per-32-group scales; A/B data is mvin'd DIRECTLY
      // from DRAM (no host-side block memcpy — that was 98% of the cycles).
      for (int g = 0; g < MATMUL_K / 32; g++) {
        memcpy(&A_s[g][0], &A_scales_row[g][i0 * BLK], BLK);
        memcpy(&B_s[g][0], &B_scales_col[g][j0 * BLK], BLK);
      }

      // Dynamically position B matrix at top of scratchpad based on actual tiles_J
      uint32_t a_base = 0;
      uint32_t b_base = BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS - tiles_K * tiles_J * DIM;
      int SPAD_DEST = 128;

      // PROF accel
      gemmini_flush(0);
      gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY, 1, 1, 0, 0, false, 0, 0, 3, 0);
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)A_s, A_S_BYTES, 0);
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)B_s, B_S_BYTES, 1);

      // Load A tiles: only load tiles_I x tiles_K tiles
      gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_K * sizeof(elem_t));      // A rows: stride K (full block-aligned tiles)
      for (int i = 0; i < tiles_I; i++)
        for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++)
          gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in) + (i0 * BLK + i * DIM) * MATMUL_K + k * DIM),
                                a_base + (i * tiles_K + k) * DIM, DIM, DIM);

      // Load B tiles: only load tiles_K x tiles_J tiles with dynamic layout
      gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_N * sizeof(elem_t));      // B rows: stride N
      for (int j = 0; j < tiles_J; j++)                  // B[k][j0*BLK+j] -> slot (k*tiles_J + j)
        for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++)
          gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + (k * DIM) * MATMUL_N + (j0 * BLK + j * DIM)),
                                b_base + (k * tiles_J + j) * DIM, DIM, DIM);

      // Configure requantizer with dynamic bounds
      gemmini_config_st(OUT_COLS * sizeof(out_t));
      gemmini_mxquant_config_mvout((uint64_t)scale_factors, tiles_I, tiles_J, tiles_K, 0, 0, 1);

      // Compute with dynamic tile sizes
      gemmini_loop_ws_spad(tiles_I, tiles_J, tiles_K, pad_i, pad_j, 0, a_base, b_base, 0,
                           SPAD_DEST, false, false, false, false, false, NO_ACTIVATION, 0, 0, false, 0x38);

      // Read results from shared memory - BF16 values are packed 4 per uint64
      int output_words_per_row = (ncols + BF16_PER_WORD - 1) / BF16_PER_WORD;
      for (int r = 0; r < mrows; r++) {
        gemmini_mx_read_smem(&C_hw[i0 * BLK + r][j0 * BLK / BF16_PER_WORD],
                             SPAD_DEST * 16 + r * tiles_J * DIM, 
                             output_words_per_row * BF16_PER_WORD);
      }
      gemmini_fence();
    }
}
```
